## Historical execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations below identify supplied source IDs and exact lines. Expanded files are under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/`; their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, with member paths formed by prefixing the relative paths below with `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/`.

### Selection: kitchen corner, commons_133800864

The selected step-3 code constructs cabinets, 39 tilted blind slats, sink layers and faucet, paper holder, pitcher, jug and blender from boxes, rods, balls and swept tubes. The jug is an Asset with separate body, shoulders, neck and cap; the blender cup is a separately generated 64-sided, leaning ring mesh. Two modeled towel surfaces have thickness and subdivision modifiers. These are intended arrangements, not proof that parts physically contact or match the image. [X0437, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/003/build.py`, lines 14–106, 172–246]

The code creates procedural noise/ramp and bump for granite, noise bump for paper and cloth, and a metallic nickel material. It attempts assignment by mesh-name matching after realization; the render log’s generic Box/Rod/Ball names mean those intended assignments should not all be assumed effective. The cup plastic requests transmission 0.72; a text label and seeded emboss curves are also created. [X0437, same file, lines 108–170, 219–289; X0438, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/003/result.json`, line 5]

The camera is at (-1.43, -2.92, 2.10), aimed at (.04, .08, 1.65), lens 78; two area lights and a 0.34-strength world are specified. Code requests Cycles, 48 samples, denoising and 384×512, but the execution log reports **16/16 samples**, not 48. [X0437, lines 291–318; X0438, lines 2–7]

Step 1 failed before rendering because the sink fillet exceeded half its smallest dimension; step 2 failed on a null world. Step 3 creates a world if necessary and successfully saved `final.png` and `scene.blend`. [X0434, `selection/commons_133800864/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0436, `.../steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0437, lines 295–309; X0438, lines 2–7]

### Selection: kitchen island, commons_138420790

The selected build uses box assemblies for the room, cabinetry, appliances, three-drawer island and layered shallow sink; the tap is a base, swept arch and lever, and the kettle has separate body, lid and handle. Wood and plaster use procedural noise and bump; world-space bounding boxes select post and hood finishes and a spatial rule targets metallic parts. These bounds are assignment tests, not contact measurements. [X0448, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/003/build.py`, lines 17–38, 73–185, 187–256]

The code specifies camera (-5.35, -3.85, 1.68), lens 52, shift -0.023, four area lights, Cycles 64 samples, denoising and 384×512. Step 1 failed on a null world; steps 2 and 3 saved renders and blends. Step 3 logged 16/16 samples despite the 64-sample code request. [X0448, lines 258–286; X0445, `selection/commons_138420790/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0447, `.../steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0449, `.../steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]

### Selection and validation limits

Both selection files specify step 3, although each record’s `selected` field is null. Records report valid and functional passes for the blender base and arched tap respectively, expressly limited to structural/edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Reported overall scores are 0.403 and 0.430, not independently validated visual acceptance. No images were supplied for visual inspection, so successful rendering cannot establish fidelity or rule out a poor reconstruction. [X0431, `selection/commons_133800864/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0430, `.../record.json`, lines 16–34, 57; X0442, `selection/commons_138420790/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0441, `.../record.json`, lines 16–34, 57]

### Test and separate development evidence

For workshop test commons_155212263, both generated programs describe elaborate benches, lathes, flywheels and tools; the second reduces geometry and requests 16 samples, but creates noise nodes per material despite its “shared” comment. Both executions timed out without an image; the record reports missing artifacts and failed validation, not a visually assessed poor render. The requested blue bench edit was not attempted: editor calls were zero. [X0455, `test/commons_155212263/steps/002/build.py`, lines 83–98, 110–158, 267–303; X0454, `.../steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0456, `.../steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0451, `test/commons_155212263/record.json`, lines 16–31, 46–50; X0458, `.../text_edit/status.json`, lines 2–5]

The other test record reports missing artifacts and generated-program/execution failure, but supplied step-level evidence does not establish its immediate cause. A separate development scene’s step 3 did render and save, but its code and visual quality are not supplied. [X0459, `test/commons_16007442/record.json`, lines 16–31, 46–50; X0427, `development/commons_118588033/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7]
